'''Joe Boulden''' was a Decipher digital artist and the 3D project manager of the [[Jedi Knights Trading Card Game]] (2001), coordinating the Art Department's work on it. He found 3D modelers who had made ''Star Wars'' fan art, in eleven countries, and Decipher bought and enhanced their models.<ref name="jkrules">[http://www.decipher.com/jediknights/rules/jediknightsrules.txt ''Jedi Knights'' Trading Card Game rulebook (credits)], Decipher (2001). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010820125115/http://www.decipher.com:80/jediknights/rules/jediknightsrules.txt Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="jkpersonae">[http://www.decipher.com/jediknights/designdiary/personae.html Design Diary: Dramatis personae], decipher.com (2000–2001). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010224092942/http://www.decipher.com:80/jediknights/designdiary/personae.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="jkd102500">[http://www.decipher.com/jediknights/designdiary/entries/102500.html Design Diary, 25 October 2000], decipher.com. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001208001800/http://www.decipher.com:80/jediknights/designdiary/entries/102500.html Internet Archive]</ref>
